product_from_film: Typeless is a mobile voice keyboard for dictation, spoken edits and translation inside other apps.
explains_well: The same text is dictated, translated, reformatted and shortened, making the edit chain easy to compare.
unclear: Repeated explanations delay the next action, and small text makes it hard to judge exactly what was removed or preserved.
scenario: Dictate a note, revise it by voice and write a translated social reply
product_clear_basis: Founder introduction names Dictate, Edit and Translate with app controls.

lessons.keep: Keep the same content through dictation and successive voice edits.
try: Cut repeated explanations and show each command immediately beside a before/after text comparison.
Zoom into the pen and Translate gestures, then hold the resulting changed sentence instead of the whole phone screen.
lessons.avoid: Avoid making viewers wait through repeated capability claims while the screen remains unchanged.
lessons.open: Audio is unheard. Speech accuracy, translation nuance, compatibility and actual processing latency remain unverified.
